reason: KernelBench measures whether LLMs can generate correct and fast GPU kernels for a broad set of ML workloads. Although efficient kernels may be used by LLM inference systems, the paper's evaluated object is LLM-generated kernel code quality; it does not optimize LLM inference execution or serving. Therefore it is outside this collection's inference-efficiency scope.
title: KernelBench: Can LLMs Write Efficient GPU Kernels?
